lead.headline: Donalds and Jolly win Florida primaries for governor
lead.dek: Moody and Nixon take the Senate nominations as DeSantis reaches his term limit
body: Rep. Byron Donalds won Florida's Republican primary for governor Tuesday and former Rep. David Jolly won the Democratic nomination, setting the November race to succeed Gov. Ron DeSantis, who is term-limited.

Donalds, who had President Donald Trump's endorsement, took 47.8% against 25.2% for Jay Collins and 10.5% for James Fishback, with 99% counted, NBC News reported. Jolly, a former Republican, won 61% to 15.1% for Dayna Foster.
Ashley Moody took the Republican Senate nomination and Angie Nixon the Democratic, beating Alex Vindman. The Cook Political Report rates the governor's race Solid R.

briefs.headline: ABC and Disney sue the FCC over station licenses
briefs.summary: The suit filed Tuesday calls the early renewal review of eight ABC stations retaliation for Jimmy Kimmel's monologues. Chairman Brendan Carr said no decision has been made.

briefs.headline: Trump pauses 50% Canada tariffs for three days
briefs.summary: The levies on about $20B of Canadian goods were to start Wednesday. Ottawa agreed to drop measures Washington calls discriminatory against U.S. alcohol, dairy and vehicles.

briefs.headline: Agriculture Department moves to end the roadless rule
briefs.summary: Rescinding the 2001 rule would open tens of millions of acres from Alaska to Florida to roads and logging. Public comment runs through Sept. 21.

briefs.headline: UAE halts all trade with Iran indefinitely
briefs.summary: The foreign ministry said Wednesday trade and financial transactions are stopped after two ballistic missiles were detected. Tehran called the claim a false flag.

briefs.headline: Liberia agrees to take 1,200 deportees from the U.S.
briefs.summary: The first 20 arrive Thursday under a one-year deal for third-country nationals. Information Minister Jerolinmek Piah called the step humanitarian.

briefs.headline: Nine die in a Kolkata hotel fire
briefs.summary: The blaze broke out early Wednesday in a building housing several hotels; six were injured. Fire services director Anuj Sharma said victims were found in bathrooms.

briefs.headline: Morrisey declares an emergency in all 55 counties
briefs.summary: The Tuesday declaration covers storms from Sunday through Tuesday and runs 30 days. A woman died in Fayette County floodwaters.

briefs.headline: ACLU files notice of intent to sue over school funding
briefs.summary: The Aug. 17 notice, for Lincoln County students, names the attorney general, legislative leaders and the state board. Board President Paul Hardesty said he was not surprised.

regional.item: Water rose twelve feet into Sugar Creek Road homes in Charleston in under ten minutes, washing out culverts.
Thurmond, population six, voted Aug. 11 to seek counsel against the Park Service demolishing 17 structures.

briefs.headline: Spacewalk pulls a failed antenna but leaves the spare
briefs.summary: Anil Menon and Sophie Adenot worked 6 hours 23 minutes Tuesday, running long on cables and bolts. Installation moves to Aug. 25.

briefs.headline: Light-driven robots thinner than a hair carry bacteria
briefs.summary: Wuerzburg used plasmonic nanoantennas and photon recoil to steer devices under a micrometre across, which picked up bacteria and released them on command.

briefs.headline: Common blood pressure drugs tied to higher kidney risk
briefs.summary: Among 31,031 adults with type 2 diabetes, those on dihydropyridine calcium-channel blockers had a 33% greater risk of a major kidney event. The work is observational.
